table: County Business Patterns 2023: state files cbp23st and cbp23pr_ia_st (all legal forms, lfo '-') and county files cbp23co and cbp23pr_ia_co, column est
title: Who sells a campaign its polls, mailers and halls: employer establishments by place for nine NAICS industries
universe: Employer establishments with paid employees in the week of March 12, 2023; nonemployer businesses, government and most religious organizations are not counted
geography: All 56 places (50 states, D.C., Puerto Rico, Guam, the U.S. Virgin Islands, American Samoa and the Northern Mariana Islands; the island areas from the Puerto Rico and Island Areas files), with county equivalents
limits: A count of establishments, not of firms that sell to campaigns: a polling firm (NAICS 541910) also does market research, and many political consultants are coded under public relations (541820) or advertising. The Census Bureau omits county cells with fewer than three establishments ('Cells with fewer than three establishments are omitted from publication', CBP program flyer, September 2022, https://census.gov/content/dam/Census/topics/business-and-economy/flyers/cbp_sep_2022.pdf), so countiesWithAny counts county equivalents with three or more, and a state's establishments exceed inCounties plus statewideNoCounty (county code 999) by those small cells. The county table holds only the three campaign-specific industries, keyed by five-digit county GEOID. Calibrates where a campaign's seller sits (in town, in the county, elsewhere in the state); it never decides which seller one campaign picks.
method: For each place, est on the state file row with lfo '-' for the NAICS code (six digits, or three digits written '713///'); countiesWithAny and inCounties from the county files' published rows (est of three or more), excluding county code 999. The check script scripts/research/elections-sources-check.ts confirms for every place and kind that inCounties plus statewideNoCounty does not exceed establishments, that countiesWithAny does not exceed counties, that the national figures are the sums of the 56 places, and that the county table matches each place's inCounties.
